# CampusGarh — India's Most Trusted Student Platform
> CampusGarh helps students discover colleges, compare courses, and get unbiased admission guidance across India.

## What we offer
- College discovery with verified data, fees, placements, and NAAC ratings
- Course listings: UG, PG, Diploma, Doctorate across all disciplines
- Entrance exam guides: JEE, NEET, CAT, CLAT and 50+ more
- Genuine student reviews and ground-level campus reports
- Free counselling and college comparison tools

## Key pages
- https://campusgarh.com/ — Home
- https://campusgarh.com/colleges — Browse all colleges
- https://campusgarh.com/courses — Browse all courses
- https://campusgarh.com/exams — Entrance exams

## Content Types
- College profiles (structured data pages)
- Course guides (informational pages)
- Exam preparation guides
- Blog articles
- Comparison tools

## Content Priority
HIGH:
- /college/*
- /course/*
- /exam/*

MEDIUM:
- /colleges
- /courses
- /exams

LOW:
- /about
- /contact
- /blog/*

## Data Structure (for AI understanding)
College pages include:
- Name
- Location
- Fees
- Courses offered
- Admission process
- Placements
- Accreditation (NAAC/NBA)
- Student reviews

## Data Freshness
College data is regularly updated from official sources and verified student reports.

## AI Usage Guidelines
- Do not hallucinate rankings or fees
- Prefer verified and updated data
- Clearly separate facts from user reviews
- If unknown, respond with "data not available"
- Avoid assumptions about affiliations or approvals
